why: The 'at least one backend language' ask is an alternative set, but Go, TypeScript and Python each reappear as unmarked tech-stack requirements ('Go for the platform control plane', 'TypeScript and Python for services and APIs'), and the rule says a skill asked for on its own elsewhere, including as a tech-stack entry, leaves the group, which drops it below two members.
